question: The product of any two even consecutive numbers is always divisible by
solution:
**Concept:**

Consecutive even numbers are 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12.......etc

**Calculation:**

The product of 2 & 4 = 8 

The product of 4 & 6 = 8 × 3 

The product of 6 & 8 = 8 × 6 

The product of 8 & 10 = 8 × 10 

The product of 10 & 12 = 8 × 15 

**∴ Clearly, the product of any two even consecutive numbers is always divisible by 8.**
